new_finding: Legacy WAKE_OK records conflate later continuation observation with wake timeliness. The 14m/16m evidence has scheduled wake timestamps and later reconciliation timestamps, but no durable evidence in the audited records proves that those later timestamps were the first actual scheduled wakes.
repair: Measurement protocol now separates wake_observed from wake_timeliness/wake_lateness. Evidence table labels legacy WAKE_OK as continuation observed with timeliness unresolved.
policy_effect: SAFE_LOWER_BOUND remains 16m under the existing continuation-observed gate, but no low-idle-time claim may be derived from those legacy wake records. Phase B/D must collect direct wake timeliness.
